articles.summary: BOSTON HEIGHTS, Ohio, May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Arhaus, Inc. (“Arhaus” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: ARHS), a premium home furnishing brand known for responsibly sourced, artisan-crafted products and heirloom-quality design, reported first quarter results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: Arhaus Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
